rules.check: Every changed USD, Kit SDK, or `omni.ui` API use is verified against its matching repository MCP source when available, otherwise against version-appropriate official documentation or established repository code.
Every changed user-visible data mutation is implemented as an `omni.kit.commands.Command`.
Each changed command implementation lives in the relevant `.core` extension's `commands.py`.
Each changed command captures all state needed by `undo()` before `do()` mutates data.
Changed command `do()` and `undo()` methods never call `omni.kit.commands.execute()`.
Changed callers execute commands through `omni.kit.commands.execute()` rather than invoking `do()` directly.
Each changed command execution string exactly matches its command class name.
Changed multi-command user actions use one `omni.kit.undo.group()` so they undo as a unit.
Each extension that directly uses `omni.kit.commands` declares that extension dependency.
Every changed USD call receives an explicit `context_name` that is preserved through the complete call chain rather than replaced by the default context.
Changed code does not manually validate application layouts.
Every changed event subscription is retained on its owning instance rather than only in a local variable.
Every lifecycle-owned subscription, model, task, window, and mutable state object has an explicit release in `on_shutdown()` or `destroy()`.

sources.section: Explicit cleanup pattern — multiple attributes to tear down

rules.check: Changed lifecycle code adds neither `default_attr` nor `reset_default_attrs`.

sources.section: Explicit cleanup pattern — multiple attributes to tear down

rules.check: A changed single-instance lifecycle exposes `get_instance()` only for an externally consumed core object; it never returns the `IExt` instance itself.
A changed context-aware lifecycle stores one core instance per `context_name` and constructs it with that same context.

sources.section: Context-aware pattern — one instance per USD context

rules.check: A changed pure-library extension has no `extension.py` and registers only Python modules.

sources.section: Pure library pattern — no lifecycle management

rules.check: Changed events use `lightspeed.events_manager` across Remix extensions and `omni.flux.utils.common.Event` within one extension's public API.
Each changed extension's role suffix matches its implemented responsibility for `.core`, `.widget`, `.window`, `.menu`, `.model`, `.service`, `.plugin.*`, `.app.resources`, `.style`, or `.bundle`.
The changed feature-layer dependency graph is `entry -> {.widget, .core}`.
Each changed reusable UI component is built on `omni.ui.Frame` or `omni.ui.Stack` and does not own an `omni.ui.Window`.
Changed reusable `.widget` code contains presentation and interaction events but no business processing.
Each changed Remix style has one canonical definition in the shared application stylesheet.

sources.section: Layout spacing — no inline style dicts

rules.check: Changed UI reuses an existing icon or color for an existing concept; when no icon fits, a new icon prefers the MDI library.

sources.section: Use existing icons for existing concepts

rules.check: Changed user-facing UI text is complete, neutral, professional, and uses full words.
Changed UI elements that form one row, column, or scrolling region have pixel-aligned edges and consistent insets.
Every changed user-interactive UI element exposes a stable identifier suitable for automation and stylesheet targeting.
Changed UI uses content-driven or fill sizing and stack spacing before introducing a fixed dimension.
Every changed explicit UI dimension uses `ui.Pixel`, `ui.Fraction`, or `ui.Percent`; only literal zero may remain raw.

sources.section: Use `omni.ui` dimension objects, not raw floats

rules.check: Each changed shared USD property tooltip identifies the field and current value using the documented scalar, vector-channel, or color format.
Changed tree UI layer order is outer background, inner overlay with `separate_window=True` separator frames, then footer.
Changed `ScrollingTreeWidget` UI supplies its opaque background from a parent `Rectangle` rather than patching the transparent internal scrolling frame.
Each changed tree delegate `_build_widget` and `_build_header` body is wrapped in a fixed-height `ui.Frame`.
Changed tree columns use equal sentinel spacers at both ends.
Changed tree column separators omit the drag-handle leading edge.
Each changed widget returned by `WorkspaceWindowBase._create_window_ui()` implements concrete `show(visible: bool)` behavior without an incompatible ABC mixin.
A changed alternating-row tree's empty-state overlay fully covers its current viewport after every model mutation.
Changed tree cell and header labels inherit the default font size unless the element is intentionally compact.
Changed fixed-height icons inside an `HStack` are vertically centered by a `VStack` with flanking spacers.

rules.check: Changed context menus triggered by `mouse_pressed_fn` use `ui.Menu.show()` rather than passing widget-local coordinates to `show_at()`.
Every changed `ui.Image` sets explicit nonzero `width` and `height`.
